chrome-devtools.description: ADR-0038 (Issues #174, #224). A browser for product-lead's read-only sweep, bounded by origin. Since #224, when the project declares an http(s) origin, it attaches to the owner's own running Chrome (--autoConnect, the stable channel's default profile), so it drives a browser holding his logins and Chrome asks him to allow the connection; with no declared origin it launches a throwaway profile (--isolated) bound to the discard port, so no prompt appears and none of his tabs is touched. The shell reads HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN when the server starts, from the environment the harness gives it, which carries the project's settings env. With no value, or one that does not begin http:// or https://, the origin is the discard port, so the browser reaches nothing. The package is pinned to one exact version and fetched with install scripts off.
args: o=$HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN; case "$o" in http://*|https://*) m=--autoConnect ;; *) o='http://127.0.0.1:9/*'; m=--isolated ;; esac; exec npx --ignore-scripts -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.8.0 $m --channel stable --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux --allowedUrlPattern "$o"
